structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות ניירות ערך and buy the "ילין לפידות קרן מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund each month, the pair the page marks "הזול". With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years that's 135,000 ₪ in, and the page says I'd end up with about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום". I couldn't find what inflation rate it uses. It just says the result is in today's money.

stuck.why: I clicked it twice. The first click maybe changed the grey line a bit (it said "לדוגמה של האתר" before), the second did nothing. I never saw a percent for inflation, so I don't know what it assumes.
Not clear if the 7% is before or after inflation, when the result says "בכסף של היום".
I typed 750 and the box shows 750, but the slider under it says 800. Small thing, but for a second I wasn't sure which one counts.

findings.what: The "אינפלציה" button doesn't show any number for inflation, and clicking it didn't seem to do anything I could see. I still don't know what rate it uses.
The 7% return has no note saying if it's before or after inflation, even though the result is "בכסף של היום"
I typed 750 in the box but the slider jumped to 800, so I wasn't sure which number it used
The two top options are only 122 ₪ apart over 15 years, so I can't really tell them apart
The cost bar has lots of colours and the legend is far away; the small parts (596, green bit) mean nothing to me
Too many filter chips with jargon (עסקת החלף, צוברת, מנוטרלת מט״ח)
